critical_code_review_comments: portal/routes.py is ~10195 lines (>>700). Should be split into feature-scoped modules (auth, twofa, tickets, dcim, form_builder, billing, backup, utm) for maintainability - non-blocking but strongly recommended.
public form submit path enforces recaptcha via iv2.enforce_recaptcha (currently disabled in DB per instructions) - once re-enabled, ensure the same 422/detail.errors contract still holds.

_paginate returning either list OR dict depending on presence of ?page is convenient for BC but hurts OpenAPI typing and forces defensive frontend code. Consider a dedicated /admin/invoices/paginated route long-term.
public_form_submit swallows followup insertion errors silently (try/except pass) - acceptable but log at warn level for observability.
